newsitem.title: USA: Paracelsus shrs fall more than 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Paracelsus shrs fall more than 50 pct.

text.p: Shares in Paracelsus Healthcare Corp plunged by half in their first trading since Wednesday night, when the company announced earnings for the just-completed third quarter would be well below expectations.
The company also said Wednesday that it might have to restate financial results for the previous three quarters.
Paracelsus opened at 4-7/8, down 5-1/4 from its Wednesday closing price of 10-1/8. The shares failed to open for trading yesterday.
In late morning trade, shares were off 5-1/4 on the day at 4-7/8.
